'''Willar''' is a small village in [[Ghealdan]], east of the [[River Boern]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Willar}}

==Activities==
[[Rand al'Thor]] passed through the village on his way to [[Tear]]. [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] find that the village spring began to flow again about a day after Rand's visit.{{ref/book|3|33}}
